name: Exploratory pilot planning
audience: Founders uncertain whether a bounded service can be delivered and valued
scope: Prepare one proposed pilot without implying a sale or permission to contact

sources.citation: Original Startkompas procedural worksheet: templates/experiment-paid-pilot.json, version 1. Guidance only; not independent research or customer evidence.

review.review_route: Repository issue or pull request with a reproducible scope problem and proposed correction. Obtain qualified review before making specialist claims.

templates.name: Bounded paid pilot
templates.audience: People choosing a bounded way to investigate a specific business uncertainty
templates.scope: Prepare a small proposed paid engagement to learn about delivery and observed value in one explicit context.
unknowns: Suitable participants, permissions, materials and access until explicitly confirmed
Actual observations and outcomes until recorded with sources
boundaries: Cannot establish payment, profit, repeatability, retention or wider demand until relevant actual records exist; one pilot cannot establish general demand.
This worksheet does not record execution, observations, validation or payments
Record actual results separately with provenance; retain later changes to the decision rule
User-supplied dates cannot prove a plan preceded execution

sections.prompt: Which delivery or value uncertainty would a bounded pilot investigate?

Prepare a proposed deliverable, exclusions, acceptance check, feedback questions, payment terms to discuss and a blank delivery log. Separate proposal, accepted agreement, work delivered and actual payment records. Reuse an existing offer or pilot record explicitly if available.
Which customer situation and decision-maker role would fit? Participants, agreement, access and willingness to pay remain unknown until actually recorded.
Set proposed effort and cash limits, required materials and dependencies. Compare expected revenue and costs without assuming payment or unpaid work; record unknown estimates.
Plan to retain delivery evidence, actual effort and cost, customer feedback and payment status as separate sourced records. Do not infer satisfaction from delivery or receipt of money alone.
Which observed delivery, value and effort outcomes would justify repeating, changing or stopping? Define the decision before delivery and retain later changes.
Set a maximum time/cost and explicit pause conditions for scope changes or missing agreement/access. This plan authorizes no spending, billing, contract, outreach or execution.

checks.prompt: Which uncertain assumption could this pilot disprove?
What is the explicit effort cap and stop condition?
What actual observation would contradict the proposed value?
